heading: How We Work
subtext: A clear five-step process from first conversation to deployed product.

example.label: A real example
example.quote: "Our team spends three hours every morning copying order data from emails into Excel, then sending the summary to managers."
example.result: A Python script now reads the inbox at 8 am, pulls out the structured data, updates the master workbook and emails the formatted report to three managers. The three-hour task takes zero minutes of human time.

steps.title: Discover
steps.description: We listen to your problem, ask the right questions and map out exactly what needs to be built.

steps.title: Plan
steps.description: We choose the right technology and create a clear plan before writing a single line of code.

steps.title: Build
steps.description: We develop and test iteratively. You see progress throughout, not just a finished product at the end.

steps.title: Test
steps.description: You run it in your real environment. We fix anything that does not work as expected.

steps.title: Launch
steps.description: We deploy, document and stay available for questions, tweaks and future additions.
